title: Figure 6: nuclear fusion of deuterium and tritium reaction diagram
description: Particle diagram showing tritium (³H) and deuterium (²H) nuclei, drawn as red and blue spheres, converging on a central fusion point and producing a helium-4 nucleus ("⁴He + 3.5 MeV") and a neutron ("n + 14.1 MeV"). Captioned "Figure 6. Nuclear Fusion of Deuterium and Tritium." It appears in a section on fusion initiation methods and Coulombic repulsion.
